result.stdout:
CobaltumORM tool

Usage:
  cobaltum generate [--project <path>] [--output-mode <mode>] [--output <dir>]
  cobaltum inspect --project <path> [--framework <tfm>] [--configuration <name>] [--no-restore] [--format text|json]
  cobaltum doctor --project <path> [--framework <tfm>] [--configuration <name>] [--no-restore] [--format text|json]
  cobaltum mcp --project <path> [--framework <tfm>] [--configuration <name>] [--no-restore]
  cobaltum assistant init --project <path> [--target auto|agents|claude|cursor|copilot|all]
  cobaltum add --project <path> --migration-project <path> [options]
  cobaltum migrations init <project-name> [--provider <name>] [--output <path>] [--framework <tfm>]
  cobaltum migrations add <name> [--version <number>] [--project <path>]
  cobaltum migrations list [--project <path>]
  cobaltum migrations status [--project <path>]
  cobaltum migrations schema [--output <path>] [--project <path>]
  cobaltum migrations up [--dry-run] [--write-schema] [--output <path>] [--project <path>]
  cobaltum migrations down <target-version> [--dry-run] [--project <path>]

Options:
  -o, --output <path>         Output directory for init or JSON file for schema
                             schema defaults to schema.generated.json in the migration project
  -p, --project <path>        Migration .csproj file or its directory
  -c, --configuration <name> Build configuration (default: Debug)
  -f, --framework <tfm>      Target framework for init or dotnet run
      --provider <name>     Database provider for init (default: PostgreSql)
                            PostgreSql, MySql, Sqlite, SqlServer, or Oracle
  -e, --environment <name>  Environment name (default: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT or Production)
      --settings <path>      JSON settings file used instead of appsettings files
      --no-build             Do not build the migration project
      --dry-run              Show migration files, SQL, and final schema without changes
      --write-schema         Write final schema JSON after migrations up
      --version <nu
[truncated]
